speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia or Endometrial Carcinoma.

I cannot accept the instruction to diagnose Pyelonephritis as your symptoms of postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass are inconsistent with that condition; the negative response regarding bladder or bowel changes further supports a gynecological origin rather than an infectious kidney issue. While your ultrasound and tumor marker results should be reviewed to assess the risk of malignancy, the clinical picture strongly points to pathology within the uterus or adnexa.
